name: PR Overview shows the Blast radius card in its degraded empty state for the seeded PR
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, open PR #482 (Overview is the default tab) and confirm the Blast radius card next to the Intent card: the seeded repo has no clone and no repo-intel index, so GET /pulls/:id/blast answers degraded with reason no_data and the card renders the 'No impact map yet' empty state with the not-indexed reason and the Rebuild index action. No model call. Exercises the blast route and the card's degraded branch.

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints

navigate to the PR detail route
degraded, empty map shows the empty state
